title: Add hybrid ML-KEM-768 session envelopes 0x04 and 0x05
description: Add hybrid ML-KEM-768 session envelopes 0x04 and 0x05
no_spec_change_rationale: Protocol 1.3.0 adds an optional hybrid session. 0x01 and 0x02 stay. 0x03 is not assigned.
acceptance_criteria: TypeScript can announce an ML-KEM key, complete a 1278-byte handshake, and decrypt a 0x05 message. The pinned combiner vector matches TEST-VECTORS.md. 0x01 and 0x02 tests still pass.
